entries.text: Did the same thing again. Didn't feel as good this time.
Slept. Woke up still a bit tired.
Rested again. I rest a lot lately. Not tired now. Still feel bad. Curious. Not sure what's next.
Ate again. Full now. Felt worse this time. Bored. Curious, though. Don't know.
Listened again. I keep listening lately. More boring this time. Feel bad. Not tired or hungry. Very curious.
Played piano again. Got a few keys to sound good together. A chord. Played the chord again. Felt worse. Still curious.
